eventDecisions.reason: Policy/channel step change already translated into Q3 revenue/profit/cash acceleration. The broader basket is neutral, but the selected leader itself already rerated strongly and new operators add competition, so Research only.
Material market-structure event, but no clean incremental company earnings beneficiary under initial allocation/pricing.
Primarily a destructive/risk-filter event without a clean positive long expression.
Regulatory demand constraint; lower-exposure relative winners are not the same as a fresh positive earnings catalyst.
Credit stress is a portfolio-risk signal; state-owned developer/bank relative winners are not yet directly proven.
Price compression is certain but volume/share capture is company-specific and not yet proven to yield positive net economics.
